value.value: Source pp.2–3 describe DLS/aggregation and dark, cold storage: AUT dispersions remain optically clear without visible fallout despite the largest aggregates, with further-aggregation stability on the order of weeks; other ligand dispersions months. Exact storage temperature, durations and longitudinal DLS data are not given.

evidence.locator: Main PDF pp. 2–3 (printed pp. 4749–4750), Results: characterization and storage-stability continuation
Main PDF pp. 2–3 (printed pp. 4749–4750), Results: characterization and storage-stability continuation

value.value: The study uses shell-free CdSe QDs, nominal 3/5/10 nm core sizes, and four thiol-bound ligands. MUA/AUT are long C11 ligands; MPA C3 and CYST C2 are short. Charge, ligand length and size comparisons are source-study interpretations, not a universal material safety hierarchy.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2 (printed p. 4749), Study design; p.7 Discussion
Main PDF p. 2 (printed p. 4749), Study design; p.7 Discussion

value.value: Authors tentatively rank surface charge, functionalization/ligand length and core size in their NHBE cytotoxicity study; positive QDs generally cause stronger responses. Cd/Se balance and AUT interaction, mitochondrial injury/uncoupling, and ROS-independent toxicity are proposed explanations, not independently measured composition, uptake or a proven unique mechanism. Smaller/long-ligand and concentration effects retain assay-specific exceptions.

value.value: At 20 µg/mL, the source estimates nominal 10 nm suspensions contain 1.5–2.5 orders of magnitude fewer QDs than 3 nm suspensions. This prose estimate is not a reconstructed particle-number concentration; the SI conversion table was not reviewed.

value.value: Main text describes free Cd2+ controls corresponding to maximum Cd content in 0.5/5/20/80/160 µg/mL QD exposures and differing necrotic responses. SI Figure 3 was not inspected. SI also reportedly contains ligand-only controls, TEM table, mass/molar/particle conversions, 96-gene list, and CYST 3 nm 80/160 µg/mL necrosis. No SI observations or methods are imported as independently reviewed data.

quality.review_scope: Independent review of all 15 main pages and consolidated correction delta accepted. SI and cited prior methods unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: No atomic-coordinate asset or crystallographic phase assignment reported in the scoped main text.
This is a biological characterization context, not an additional CdSe synthesis or structural pair.
No numerical bar/curve digitization; exact plotted evidence is retained as source crops.
conflicts: Negative MUA/MPA: 20, 80, 160 µg/mL. Positive dose labels differ by assay/panel: general methods 0.5, 5, 20 µg/mL; Figures 2B, 3D, 4B, 5B use 0.5, 3.5, 20; Figure 3B images and Figures 5D/6 use their explicit labels. Never merge 3.5 and 5.
Table 4 positive/negative symbols are literal dose-count summaries, not effect sizes and not a replacement for conflicting prose or figure-specific dose labels.
